title: Make all 10 languages apply instantly and completely across all games and content

requirements.text: Ensure that when a user selects any supported language (tr, en, es, fr, de, it, ru, pt, zh, ja), every screen, game, and UI string updates immediately and shows 100% in the selected language with no English (or other language) leftovers anywhere in the app.

quotes: Uygulama 10 dil tarafından destekleniyor. Hangi dil seçilirse uygulama anında tüm bileşenleriyle tüm kısımlarıyla tüm içeriğiyle o dile dönecek. Yani tüm dilleri yüzde yüz destekleyecek
Türkçe çevirilerde sorun var özellikle hafıza oyunu, puzzle oyunu, problem vs bulunduğu kısımda ingilizce kalıyor ... yüzde yüz olmalı uygulamanın her yerşinde

acceptanceCriteria: Switching language from the language selector updates the visible text on the current screen without requiring a refresh or navigation.
In Turkish (tr), Memory Card Game, Logic Puzzle Game, and Problem Solving Game contain zero English UI strings (headers, buttons, helper text, toasts, labels).

For each supported language, there are no obvious untranslated UI strings in Game Zone, Quiz Zone, Coloring Zone, and shared components like Header/Footer/CelebrationModal (spot-check by switching languages and visiting each zone).

requirements.text: Audit and fix frontend components so they do not render hardcoded English strings for game UI; all user-facing strings in Memory Card Game, Logic Puzzle Game, and Problem Solving Game must come from the translation system (useTranslation + translations dictionary) and be present for all 10 languages.

quotes: Türkçe ... hafıza oyunu, puzzle oyunu, problem ... ingilizce kalıyor ... türkçe çevirir yüzde yüz olmalı

acceptanceCriteria: Memory Card Game: all labels (including theme/category labels like farm animals/wild animals/space adventures/cultural landmarks/etc.), instructions, and toasts are translated for all 10 languages.
Logic Puzzle Game: difficulty labels, puzzle category labels, prompts, buttons, and any feedback text are translated for all 10 languages.
Problem Solving Game: scenario intro UI, selection/submit controls, correctness feedback, and category labels are translated for all 10 languages.
No component in these games uses English string literals for user-visible text except through translations (e.g., no raw 'Select answer', 'Correct!', etc.).

requirements.text: Complete translation-key coverage in frontend/src/lib/translations.ts so that es/fr/de/it/ru/pt/zh/ja do not silently fall back to English for keys used in Game Zone, Quiz Zone, and Coloring Zone (including sub-features like Daily Surprise labels and in-game category labels).
acceptanceCriteria: For every key accessed via useTranslation in the app, translations exist for all 10 languages (tr, en, es, fr, de, it, ru, pt, zh, ja).
When switching to any non-English language, Game Zone cards (names/descriptions), Daily Surprise card labels, and in-game category labels do not revert to English due to missing keys.
Add a dev-time safeguard (e.g., console warning in development builds) when a translation key is missing for the active language, so missing coverage is detectable during testing.

requirements.text: Ensure backend-provided user-facing text fully supports all 10 languages where the backend is the source, including encouragement messages returned by getEncouragementMessage; no supported language should receive an English fallback like 'Keep going!' due to missing language arrays.
acceptanceCriteria: getEncouragementMessage returns a message in the requested backend Language for all supported languages (#turkish, #english, #spanish, #french, #german, #italian, #russian, #portuguese, #chinese, #japanese).
No supported language results in an empty message set that triggers the hardcoded fallback string.
Spot-check: requesting encouragement messages for level 1 in each language returns a non-empty localized message in that language.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*.
Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister; place all logic in backend/main.mo and add backend/migration.mo only if an existing stable state schema must change.
nonGoals: Adding new languages beyond the existing 10 supported language codes.
Integrating external i18n libraries or third-party translation services.
Changing unrelated gameplay logic, scoring, or adding new games.
